title: An even-length walk
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph on a finite vertex set $V$. Suppose every pair of vertices is connected by a finite sequence of neighbor steps, and no Boolean coloring assigns opposite colors across every neighbor step. For any vertices $u,v$, there is a list of neighbor-slot choices of even length strictly less than $2|V|$ whose walk from $u$ ends at $v$.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is connected by finite sequences of neighbor steps
$G$ has no Boolean coloring that flips across every neighbor step
